column1: # 3 of 3 resolve to a pinned version. ACTION QT FIRES ON LIMB 1 for the GNU axis.
# NOTE: these stay CLAIMED-IN-PROSE, not GRANTED. A prose pin is still a prose claim (ACTION QN's
# own rule). What changes is that the CLAIM is now specific enough to act on.
# THE INSTRUMENT DEFECT, and it is why ACTION QE would have failed on its 4th carry:
#   The GPL preamble sentence HARD-WRAPS between the family and the version:
#     line N    "... the GNU General Public License as published by"        <- family, no version
#     line N+1  "the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the ..." <- the version
#   A LINE-BASED title window of 1 line matches the family and stops one line before the pin.
#   ACTION QE has been carried 3 passes as "re-read every GNU-family cell from the TITLE WINDOW".
#   It would have returned "unpinned" on every correctly-licensed GPL-3.0 repo in the corpus.
#   T218-4: the window must be SENTENCE-based, not line-based - join lines to the next `.` before
#   matching. Same class as T218-1: the instrument's unit was finer than the thing it measured.
